chunks: And Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who was killed and his limbs were found scattered, how should the funeral prayer be performed for him? He said:
The prayer should be performed over the part that contains his heart.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq (The Truthful), a title for Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: How is the funeral prayer performed for a person whose body parts are scattered?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) established that the heart serves as the primary anchor for the soul's presence, thereby determining the location for the funeral prayer (salat al-janazah) when a body is dismembered. This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle that the heart is the central locus of life and identity, ensuring the deceased receives proper ritual honor even in fragmented states. It underscores the importance of physical integrity in ritual practice while providing practical guidance for burial in cases of war or disaster.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5378 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about a man who was killed and whose body parts were found scattered.
How should the funeral prayer be performed for him?
Imam (as) said: "The prayer should be performed over the part that contains his heart."
